blocks.text: This page tracks the Tsawwassen MLS® Home Price Index benchmark for October 2026: $1,103,800 for a typical home, little changed at −1.4% over twelve months.
Tsawwassen benchmark prices and trends, October 2026

A typical Tsawwassen home carried an MLS® Home Price Index benchmark of $1,103,800 in October 2026. That is little changed at −0.8% on the month, little changed at −0.6% over three months, down 3.0% over six months and little changed at −1.4% over the year. Over three years it is down 9.4%, and over five years down 3.3%.
The weakest one-year move in Tsawwassen was for a townhouse homes at −7.4%; the strongest was a detached home at +0.7%.
The gap between a detached home ($1,469,500) and an apartment ($588,800) is $880,700, and a townhouse ($878,400) sits $289,600 above the apartment benchmark.
Against Greater Vancouver, where the all-home benchmark was $1,068,600, Tsawwassen is 3.3% above. Over the year Greater Vancouver moved down 5.2% against little changed at −1.4% here.
Of the 20 areas this board reports, Tsawwassen ranks 7 by all-home benchmark, with Vancouver East above it at $1,121,600 and Squamish below it at $1,100,500.

Detached homes in Tsawwassen: benchmark $1,469,500, down 2.6% in a month, little changed at −0.2% in three months, down 4.0% in six months, little changed at +0.7% in a year, down 6.8% in three years and little changed at −0.9% in five. That is 17.2% below the detached benchmark for Greater Vancouver ($1,775,200).

Townhouse homes in Tsawwassen: benchmark $878,400, little changed at −0.9% in a month, down 6.4% in three months, down 5.0% in six months, down 7.4% in a year, down 13.9% in three years and down 3.9% in five. That is 12.7% below the townhouse benchmark for Greater Vancouver ($1,006,500).

Apartment homes in Tsawwassen: benchmark $588,800, up 5.9% in a month, little changed at −0.1% in three months, down 2.9% in six months, down 7.0% in a year, down 11.9% in three years and little changed at −1.1% in five. That is 12.6% below the apartment benchmark for Greater Vancouver ($673,400).

blocks.text: In dollars, the typical Tsawwassen home is worth about $15,700 less than in October 2025, when the benchmark was near $1,119,500. By type, detached homes gained about $10,200, from $1,459,300 to $1,469,500, townhouses lost about $70,200, from $948,600 to $878,400, and apartments lost about $44,300, from $633,100 to $588,800 over those twelve months. Further back, the benchmark was near $1,137,900 six months ago and near $1,218,300 three years ago, so today's figure sits about $34,100 below the six-month mark and about $114,500 below the three-year mark. Against Greater Vancouver, the Tsawwassen benchmark is about $35,200 above the regional $1,068,600; a year earlier the difference was about $7,700 below.
Tsawwassen sales at a glance, past 12 months

Over the past year, 178 Tsawwassen houses sold at a median of $1.5M (middle half $1.33M to $1.81M), half of them within 20 days. 109 condos sold at a median of $600,000 (middle half $495,000 to $675,000), half within 40 days. Quarter by quarter, the median house price eased from $1.54M to $1.42M between November–January and August–October (26 and 44 sales).

faq.q: What is the benchmark price of a home in Tsawwassen?
faq.a: In October 2026, a typical Tsawwassen home was $1,103,800, with detached at $1,469,500.

faq.q: Are Tsawwassen home prices rising or falling?
faq.a: Tsawwassen is little changed at −1.4% over twelve months and little changed at −0.6% over three months.
